responsibility: Serves the compiled designer and an authenticated workspace interface to a browser tab from a loopback HTTP listener inside the MCP server process: the session exchange, the workspace snapshot, the activity stream and the catalogue actions, each through the workspace adapter and the operation catalogue the agent tools use.
owns: The listener: bound to 127.0.0.1 on an available port when a workspace is opened with its view, ended with its owning server, and serving the production designer build without a development server or a compilation watcher.
Browser sessions: a short-lived one-use bootstrap capability, carried in the URL fragment of the workspace view, exchanged for a scoped HttpOnly SameSite cookie and revoked on request.
The activity stream of each browser session: the sequenced events of the workspaces it may read, with bounded retention and sanitized content.
boundary: No model engine, rule or filesystem access of its own: every snapshot and action goes through the workspace adapter and the operation catalogue.

Loopback binding alone is no protection: the bootstrap exchange validates Host and Origin, enforces expiry and one-time use and rate-limits failures; every other route requires the scoped session and the origin check; a cross-origin request is refused, and no wildcard cross-origin access is granted. A request refused this way runs nothing and its body is a BrowserRejection, never a result envelope.
A bootstrap capability is never a filesystem path and is never logged; the view removes it from browser history after the exchange, and every response carries a restrictive referrer policy.
Read access cannot mutate, publish, run checks or change policy; edit access permits only the actions the workspace handle permits and never grants acceptance.
A browser session is not an agent handle: revoking it closes no agent's handle, and a remembered URL never attaches to another workspace.
Shutting the host down cancels or awaits the owned jobs within the cleanup deadline before the listener closes.

provides.name: sessionExchange
provides.concurrency: POST /api/session: exchanges a one-use bootstrap capability for a scoped browser session, set as an HttpOnly SameSite cookie, and returns the workspace handles that session may use with the access each grants; a reused or expired capability, or one from another host or origin, is rejected with a BrowserRejection.

provides.name: workspaceSnapshot
provides.concurrency: GET /api/workspaces/{workspaceId}: the adapter-verified summary of the workspace at one revision vector, with its revisions, trust states and the capabilities of the handle; it reloads from the adapter after an external file change and never opens a sample model in its place.

provides.name: activityStream
provides.concurrency: GET /api/workspaces/{workspaceId}/activity: an event-stream connection from an optional last sequence, delivering the session's events in sequence; a gap in the sequence means events were lost and a fresh snapshot is required.

provides.name: catalogueActions
provides.concurrency: POST /api/workspaces/{workspaceId}/actions: one catalogue operation with its arguments, which carry the revision expectations its input defines, validated against the input its operation names and refused as that operation refuses; an action the handle's access does not permit is refused as access-denied; it returns the same result envelope as the agent or command-line action, and a stale write fails its revision check so a dirty draft stays a draft for explicit reconciliation.

provides.name: sessionRevocation
provides.concurrency: DELETE /api/session: revokes the requesting browser session alone, leaving every agent handle and every other browser session as it was.

provides.name: requestRejection
provides.concurrency: The body of every request any route refuses before an operation runs: a host or origin the host does not serve, a missing session, an expired or reused capability, too many failures or a workspace id naming no handle of the browser session; it is never a result envelope.

provides.name: designerAssets
provides.concurrency: The compiled designer, served read-only as static files at the workspace view URL http://127.0.0.1:{port}/workspaces/{workspaceId}.
